summary: Iter28 — System 4C E2E verification. Signed in as testbuyer_iteration8 and ran 14 spec items. Passing: [1] persistence, [2] toBuyerLabel ('Submitted'), [3] ACTIVE_SOURCING -> 'Sourcing Vehicles', [4] rate limit (3rd POST returns 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED), [9] cancel (200) + already-cancelled blocked (400 CANNOT_CANCEL), [10] journey nav suppressed on 4 routes, [11] no deprecated labels, [13] wizard 0px overflow at 375 on Steps 1/2/3, [14] sessionStorage persists across reload. Failing/blocked: [5][6][12] admin flows (admin offer/notes/checkpoints API directories are EMPTY — no route.ts files), [7] buyer offer page returns 404 when no offer exists (no graceful empty state), [8] zero-offer path missing 'Adjust Your Request' CTA + refund message. CRITICAL UI bug: META JSON HTML comment leaks to buyer detail page as visible text.

critical.issue: File does NOT exist. Directory /app/frontend/app/api/admin/requests/[requestId]/offer/ is empty. Spec item [6] is BLOCKED — admin cannot create an offer, so Buyer tracker cannot transition to 'Offer Sent' and buyer offer page can never be exercised end-to-end via UI.

All admin request API directories are empty (no route.ts files). The only admin page that may work is /admin/requests/page.tsx if it queries prisma directly server-side; mutations (notes, checkpoints/complete) cannot be wired.

minor.issue: Limit is '3 requests per hour' (3rd POST 429s) — spec text said the 4th. Server message: 'You may submit up to 3 requests per hour.' Either the spec text or the limiter is off-by-one. Working as coded — flag for product confirm.

Buyer with one ACTIVE_SOURCING request in DB was still able to create 2 additional SUBMITTED requests before the rate limit fired. The 'single active request' rule mentioned in agent context note (hasActiveRequest()) does NOT appear to be enforced here. Rate limit catches it anyway, but hasActiveRequest is bypassed.

ui_bugs.issue: META JSON HTML comment leaks to buyer page as visible plain text. The notes blob renders as: 'Vehicle Type: Sedan Condition: Used Timeline: ASAP ZIP: 30309 Must-Have: Backup Camera <!--META:{"vehicleType":"Sedan","condition":"Used",...}-->'. Wizard packs <!--META:{json}--> intending it be hidden HTML comment, but the page renders notes as plain text (escaped), so users SEE the raw JSON. Also notes are shown without line breaks (newlines collapsed).
Returns 404 'Page not found' when buyer has no offer. Tested with request ab237fa4-... (SUBMITTED, no offer) — should render an empty/'no offer yet' state, not 404.
Status badge correctly shows 'Closed' (PASS), BUT 'Adjust Your Request' CTA and refund/credit messaging are MISSING — spec [8] partial.

Cancel action works via API ([data-testid=cancel-request-btn] is present on detail page) but the buyer-tracker labels list in the spec includes 'Submitted/Under Review/Sourcing Vehicles/Offer Pending/Offer Sent/Offer Accepted/Offer Declined/Deal Created/Closed/Cancelled/Expired' — most of these were not exercisable because no transitions are admin-driven (route missing). Verified the two reachable labels ('Submitted', 'Sourcing Vehicles', 'Closed').

integration_issues.issue: Spec [4] expects [data-testid=rate-limit-countdown] in the wizard after 429. Not visually verified in this run (would need to drive wizard to submission with rate-limit pre-tripped — already tripped via API but the wizard form path was not driven to the 429 again because rate limiter is per-buyer per-hour and would still fire). Recommend main agent add a Playwright step that triggers the form submission with rate-limit cookie tripped and asserts the countdown element.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Wire POST /api/admin/requests/[requestId]/offer route — directory exists but route.ts is missing. Without it offer creation is impossible, blocking [6][7].

[CRITICAL] Wire other admin request API routes: /api/admin/requests/[requestId]/route.ts (GET/PATCH), /api/admin/requests/[requestId]/notes/route.ts, /api/admin/requests/[requestId]/checkpoints/route.ts and /[checkpointId]/complete/route.ts — all directories empty.

[HIGH] Fix META JSON leak on buyer detail page: notes are rendered as plain text so '<!--META:{...}-->' shows literally. Either (a) parse + strip the comment when displaying notes, (b) render notes via dangerouslySetInnerHTML after sanitizing, or (c) move META blob out of notes into a dedicated DB column. Also apply whitespace-pre-line so newline-delimited notes render with line breaks.
[HIGH] Buyer offer page /buyer/requests/[id]/offer returns 404 when no offer exists; replace with a 'No offer yet — we’re still sourcing options' empty state.
[MEDIUM] Add 'Adjust Your Request' CTA + refund message on /buyer/requests/[id] when status === CLOSED_NO_MATCH (spec [8]).
[LOW] Resolve off-by-one between spec text ('4th submission within 1 hour returns 429') and current limit ('up to 3 per hour' so 3rd POST 429s). Decide intended behavior.
[LOW] Verify hasActiveRequest() guard — it did not block creating 2 extra requests when one ACTIVE_SOURCING request already existed for the buyer.
critical_code_review_comments: Storing wizard metadata as a hidden HTML comment inside a plain-text notes column is fragile — any UI that renders notes with whitespace-pre-line/escaped text will leak the JSON to the user (this happened). Recommend a real column (e.g., metadata Json @db.JsonB) on VehicleRequest.

Many admin API route directories were created but route.ts files never landed. Suggest a CI guard (`find app/api -type d ! -empty -prune -o -type d -empty -print`) to fail the build when an api/ directory has no route.ts.

Buyer-facing detail page should never 404 when the underlying request exists but a child resource (offer) is missing — distinguish between 'request not found' (404) and 'no offer yet' (200 with empty state).
Cancel state-machine response uses CANNOT_CANCEL with a generic message; consider returning the current status so the UI can render context (e.g., 'Cannot cancel — deal already created').

rca of the issue:
Admin request API routes were scaffolded as empty directories on Apr 23 (timestamps confirm) and the route.ts files were never authored — likely a partial commit. The buyer offer page 404 is because Next.js App Router treats a missing data record as not-found in the page's data fetch (redirect/notFound() called) instead of rendering an empty offer state. The META JSON leak happens because the buyer detail page renders the notes column as plain text inside a

with default whitespace handling — the wizard-side trick of using assumes the notes will be rendered as HTML, which they are not.
